concerns.text: T003 specifies aggregating metrics into a 'single subject-level Variability_Metric (mean edge SD)', but `dataset.schema.yaml` requires 10 PCA components (`PCA_Component_1` through `PCA_Component_10`). This creates a deterministic failure during contract verification in T011.

T006 mandates 'phase-shuffled surrogate time-series', but `plan.md` (Complexity Tracking) explicitly rejects phase-shuffling as 'trivial' and requires an 'AR Surrogate Null Model'. The task is executable but implements the wrong methodology.

T002 fails to implement checksumming of downloaded/processed data, which is a non-negotiable requirement of Constitution Principle III ('Datasets MUST be checksummed and the checksum recorded under data/').
